<h1>Datasets</h1><div class="ac-section ac-dataset" id="czechoslovak-foreign-trade"><h2><a href="czechoslovak-foreign-trade.html">Czechoslovak foreign trade</a></h2><p class="ac-item-meta">Annual: 1920–1938 · Monthly: 1924–1938 · Fifteen partner economies</p><p>National exports, imports and trade balances; annual bilateral flows and shares; growth rates and 1929-based indices.</p><p><a href="czechoslovak-foreign-trade.html">Data overview and figures</a> · <a download="" href="assets/files/datasets/Czechoslovak_Foreign_Trade_Interwar_Dataset.xlsx">Excel workbook</a></p></div><div class="ac-section ac-dataset" id="czechoslovakia-eer"><h2><a href="czechoslovakia-eer.html">Czechoslovakia’s effective exchange rates</a></h2><p class="ac-item-meta">Annual · NEER: 1920–1938 · REER: 1923–1938 · 1929 = 100</p><p>Companion dataset for <em>The Crown Against the World</em>: fourteen partners, twenty-six index variants, annual weights and basket coverage.</p><p><a href="czechoslovakia-eer.html">Data overview, figures and methods</a> · <a download="" href="assets/files/datasets/Czechoslovakia_EER_1920_1938.xlsx">Excel workbook</a> · <a href="https://doi.org/10.3886/E251023V1">openICPSR DOI</a></p></div>
<div class="ac-section ac-dataset" id="financial-stress-under-the-gold-standard">
<section class="level2" id="measuring-financial-stress-under-the-gold-standard">
<h2 data-anchor-id="measuring-financial-stress-under-the-gold-standard">Measuring Financial Stress under the Gold Standard</h2>
<p class="ac-item-meta">
Czechoslovakia · Monthly · November 1929–September 1938
</p>
<p>Eleven financial and macro-financial indicators and a composite financial-stress index. The dataset contains 107 monthly observations, the underlying and transformed series, and documentation for reconstructing financial pressure during the Czechoslovak Depression.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.openicpsr.org/openicpsr/project/247312/version/V1/view">Dataset and documentation</a> · DOI: 10.3886/E247312V1</p>
</section>
</div>
<div class="ac-section ac-dataset" id="european-bilateral-trade-geography">
<section class="level2" id="european-bilateral-trade-19271938">
<h2 data-anchor-id="european-bilateral-trade-19271938">European bilateral trade, 1927–1938</h2>
<p class="ac-item-meta">
21 European economies · Annual · Country-pair-year observations
</p>
<p>A bilateral trade panel covering twelve annual cross-sections. It can be used to study changes in trade partners, the persistence of commercial relationships and the geography of European trade during the Great Depression.</p>
<p>Repository title: <em>Commercial Hysteresis: Persistence and Reorganization in Europe’s Bilateral Trade Geography during the Great Depression.</em></p>
<p><a href="https://doi.org/10.3886/E247132V2">Dataset and documentation</a> · DOI: 10.3886/E247132V2</p>
</section>
</div>
<section class="level2 ac-section ac-dataset" id="the-missing-j">
<h2 data-anchor-id="the-missing-j">The Missing J</h2>
<p class="ac-item-meta">
Europe · Monthly · 1925–1936
</p>
<p><em>The Missing J in Interwar Europe: A Monthly Cliometric Dataset on Effective Exchange Rates and Trade-Balance Adjustment, 1925–1936.</em></p>
<p>A dataset linking exports, imports, prices, economic activity and exchange rates. Annual bilateral trade weights from League of Nations trade reports support the construction of effective exchange rates. Country and variable coverage are documented in the deposit.</p>
<p><a href="https://doi.org/10.3886/E251239V1">Dataset and documentation</a> · DOI: 10.3886/E251239V1</p>
</section>
</section>
